actions.note: Round 1 income is min(round+1,6)=2. Cinder Scout for 1.
Dust Weaver for 2. Its Bolster trigger finds no other friendly character; the target is optional, so it resolves silently with no choice raised.
Ember Brand on the Scout. Attack becomes 4 (2 base at layer 0, +2 at layer 6).
Legal on the round it entered play only because Swift grants attack_while_summoning_sick.
Declining to block: trading a 1/2 into a 4-attack body is worse than taking 4. Enemy hero damage 4.
Round 2. First player alternates, so Ash acts first. It holds Smother and passes on 3 Ember.
Smother destroys the Emberkin. The branded Cinder Scout is NOT a legal target: Smother's query reads current attack (4), not printed attack (2). Pinning this is the point of the fixture.
Dust Weaver attacks; it entered play last round, so no permission is needed.
Scout blocks: 4 attack kills the 1/2 outright, and the Scout survives on 1 health with 1 damage. Simultaneous strike, so the lethal_damage state check fires once for the Weaver.

provenance.reason: Illustrates the replay format and several engine behaviours worth pinning as a conformance fixture: Swift bypassing summoning sickness, an optional target with no legal choices resolving silently, and a modifier-vs-constraint interaction.
